avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4 and increases serotonin; risk of serotonin syndrome and reduced fluoxetine efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated—do not combine; allow 5-week washout if switching from fluoxetine due to long half-life

avoid_supplements.name: SAMe (S-Adenosyl methionine)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates serotonergic activity; increases risk of serotonin syndrome
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; monitor for symptoms of serotonin syndrome if used

avoid_supplements.name: 5-HTP
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct serotonin precursor; additive serotonergic effects increase serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; counsel patient to discontinue before initiating or during fluoxetine therapy

avoid_supplements.name: Tramadol
avoid_supplements.mechanism: SNRI activity combined with SSRI; significant serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use only with close monitoring; educate on serotonin syndrome symptoms

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate serotonergic effects and increase bleeding risk via antiplatelet activity
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for increased bleeding or bruising

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild antiplatelet effects; additive with SSRI-related bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Generally safe; counsel on signs of bleeding if high-dose supplementation used

caution_supplements.name: Melatonin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Minor serotonergic activity; may cause mild additive effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive sedation or vivid dreams; dose adjustment may be needed

avoid_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (in patients on fluoxetine + monoamine oxidase inhibitors)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Risk of hypertensive crisis if fluoxetine is combined with MAOIs; fluoxetine alone does not require tyramine restriction but use caution in combination therapy
avoid_foods.action: No tyramine restriction with fluoxetine monotherapy; restrict only if co-prescribed with MAOIs—ensure 5-week washout between fluoxetine and MAOI initiation

caution_foods.name: Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: Both increase serotonergic activity and central stimulation; may increase anxiety, insomnia, or tremor
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake; advise patient to limit coffee, tea, and energy drinks; monitor for increased anxiety or sleep disturbance

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Inhibits CYP3A4; may modestly increase fluoxetine levels
caution_foods.action: Minimize consumption; no strict contraindication but counsel avoidance of large quantities

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, muscle rigidity, hyperthermia) particularly with concomitant serotonergic agents. Counsel on increased bleeding risk (particularly with NSAIDs, anticoagulants, or antiplatelet agents) and monitor for hyponatremia, especially in elderly patients during initial therapy.
